Foundation.description: Low-level query primitives for direct sidecar access, chaining, and diffing.

tools.query_raw: Direct access to any sidecar endpoint with full parameter passthrough and pagination.
tools.chain_query: Sequential multi-step queries where each step can reference prior results via $prev[N] syntax.
tools.compare_snapshots: Structured diff between two queries to the same endpoint. Returns appeared/disappeared items.

Intelligence.description: Cross-domain analysis, trend detection, and anomaly scanning.

tools.correlate: Cross-domain correlation: finds shared entities across 2+ intelligence domains.
tools.trend: Time-series trend analysis from sentinel history. Shows direction, rate of change, anomaly flags.
tools.anomaly_scan: Broad anomaly detection across all domains. Compares current values to historical baselines.

Watchlists & Alerts.description: Persistent tracking lists and threshold-based alert rules.

tools.watchlist_manage: Create, list, get, add/remove items, or delete watchlists for tracking entities.
tools.watchlist_check: Run watchlists against live data. Returns items with new activity since last check.
tools.alert_rules_manage: Create, list, get, update, or delete threshold-based alert rules.
tools.alert_check: Evaluate all active alert rules against current data. Returns triggered rules.

Aggregate.description: Broad situational awareness tools that pull from multiple sources at once.

tools.get_sitrep: Full situational report: top conflicts, market moves, weather alerts, service health.
tools.get_threat_landscape: Active threats across conflict, cyber, and crisis domains.
tools.get_market_overview: Financial markets snapshot: indices, crypto, ETF flows, sentiment, macro signals.
tools.get_cyber_intel: Cyber threat intelligence: IOCs, KEVs, phishing URLs, malware URLs, threat pulses.
tools.get_weather_environment: Weather and environment: global cities, NWS alerts, space weather.
tools.get_infrastructure_status: Critical infrastructure: power grid, water quality, radiation, USGS water.
tools.get_military_posture: Military activity: tracked aircraft, naval vessels, theater posture, ISW analysis.

Granular.description: Targeted lookups and searches for specific entities or data points.

tools.search_conflicts: Search ACLED armed conflict events by region, country, date range, or event type.
tools.search_news: Search news headlines from NewsAPI, NewsData, DoD, and NATO.
tools.lookup_ip: IP intelligence: GreyNoise, AbuseIPDB reputation, IPinfo geolocation.
tools.lookup_cve: Search for CVE vulnerabilities via Vulners.
tools.lookup_vessel: Look up a vessel by MMSI or name from AIS data.
tools.lookup_flight: Look up a military aircraft by hex code or callsign from ADS-B data.
tools.get_sanctions: Search OpenSanctions database for sanctioned entities.
tools.get_economic_data: Fetch FRED economic time series by series IDs.
tools.get_sec_filings: Search SEC EDGAR for 8-K filings or full-text search.
tools.get_disease_outbreaks: Active disease outbreaks from WHO and ReliefWeb.
tools.get_region_brief: Everything Crystal Ball knows about a location: security, conflicts, weather, alerts.

Intel Expansion.description: 16 newly-added intel sources: cyber feeds, chokepoints, internet outages, space weather, pharma supply, grid outages, disaster activations, entity LEI lookup, aviation hazards, FX rates, geocoded media events, and radiation monitoring.

tools.get_cyber_threats: Cyber threat feeds: C2 servers, IOC indicators, and malware URLs (filterable by kind).
tools.get_chokepoint_status: Maritime chokepoint transit data and trade-ton flows (Hormuz, Suez, Malacca, etc.).
tools.get_internet_outages: IODA internet outage alerts for large-scale BGP/telescope disruptions.
tools.get_space_weather_extra: Extended space weather: aurora max probability, high-latitude flag, flare-probability regions.
tools.get_pharma_supply: Drug shortages and FDA drug recalls.
tools.get_grid_outages: ORNL power grid outages by county, sorted by meters affected.
tools.get_disaster_activations: Copernicus EMS activations for major disasters worldwide.
tools.lookup_entity: GLEIF LEI lookup by company name: legal name, jurisdiction, LEI code, and status.
tools.get_aviation_hazards: SIGMETs and FAA NAS ground-stop programs.
tools.get_fx_rates: Live foreign exchange rates for a base currency.
tools.get_geo_events: GDELT geocoded media events by topic query and time window.
tools.get_radiation: BfS German gamma-dose radiation monitoring stations.

tools.help: Tool man pages, conceptual guides, and example cookbooks.
